section-1.heading: About Our School
description: Founded on 2nd April 2009, Indian Public School is spread across a 07-acre lush green campus. It is a nurturing educational institution committed to academic excellence, character building and holistic development. Guided by strong values and a student-centric approach, the school offers a balanced curriculum that seamlessly integrates scholastic learning with co-curricular and extracurricular activities.

With dedicated educators, modern facilities and a safe, inclusive environment, Indian Public School strives to empower students with the knowledge, skills and values needed to become confident, responsible and compassionate global citizens.
section-1.subHeading: A Brief Synopsis of Indian Public School, Sambalpur

cardItem.heading: Our Mission
cardItem.description: Our mission is to develop confident, responsible and compassionate learners through holistic education.

cardItem.heading: Our Vision
cardItem.description: To nurture excellence in education by inspiring students to reach their highest potential.

section-3.heading: Why Choose Indian Public School, Sambalpur
description: Eight commitments that shape daily life at Indian Public School — academic, personal and creative.

cardItem.heading: CBSE Curriculum
cardItem.description: We follow the CBSE curriculum with engaging teaching methods, regular assessments and clear learning goals to help every student succeed academically.

cardItem.heading: Experienced Faculty
cardItem.description: Dedicated and experienced teachers who guide students, support their learning and help every child reach their full potential.

cardItem.heading: Technology-Enabled Learning
cardItem.description: Modern teaching tools, digital resources and interactive learning methods make lessons engaging, effective and easy to understand.

cardItem.heading: Sports & Fitness
cardItem.description: We encourage healthy and active lifestyles through sports, games, yoga and regular physical education activities that build fitness, teamwork and confidence.

cardItem.heading: Arts & Culture
cardItem.description: We encourage creativity and self-expression through music, dance, drama and art activities that help students discover and develop their talents.

cardItem.heading: Safe & Secure Campus
cardItem.description: We prioritize student safety with a secure campus, CCTV surveillance, trained staff, first-aid facilities and safe transport arrangements.

cardItem.heading: Modern Infrastructure
cardItem.description: Our school provides spacious classrooms, well-equipped laboratories, a library and activity areas to support effective learning and overall student development.

section-4.heading: Academics
section-4.mainHeading: A Journey of Learning and Growth
description: A continuous, carefully sequenced path from first steps in the classroom to board examinations and beyond.

cardItem.heading: Nursery – UKG
cardItem.description: Play-based learning that develops early literacy, basic numeracy, creativity and social skills in a happy and caring environment.

cardItem.heading: Grades I – V
cardItem.description: Building strong foundations in English, mathematics, and other subjects through interactive classroom activities, creative learning and regular reading habits.

cardItem.heading: Grades VI – VIII
cardItem.description: Developing strong subject knowledge in science, social studies and languages through practical activities, projects, laboratory work and effective study skills.

cardItem.heading: Grades IX – X
cardItem.description: Focused preparation for CBSE board examinations through regular assessments, subject-wise guidance, revision sessions and personal mentoring to build confidence and achieve academic success.

cardItem.heading: Grades XI – XII
cardItem.description: Subject-focused learning with career guidance and support to help students prepare for higher education, competitive examinations and future career opportunities.

section-5.heading: Learning Beyond the Classroom
description: Every week brings something to try, practise and perform — because confidence is built outside the textbook too.

cardItem.heading: Sports
cardItem.description: Inter-house leagues, athletics meets and daily coaching.

cardItem.heading: Music
cardItem.description: Vocal, keyboard, percussion and school ensemble.

cardItem.heading: Dance
cardItem.description: Classical and contemporary forms, staged every term.

cardItem.heading: Art & Craft
cardItem.description: Drawing, painting, pottery and design thinking studios.

cardItem.heading: Competitions
cardItem.description: Olympiads, quizzes, MUN and inter-school festivals.

cardItem.heading: Educational Tours
cardItem.description: Field visits, heritage walks and residential trips.

cardItem.heading: Leadership
cardItem.description: Student council, house captains and peer mentoring.

cardItem.heading: Sports
cardItem.description: Inter-house leagues, athletics meets and daily coaching.

section-6.heading: Campus & Infrastructure
section-6.mainHeading: A Modern Campus for Learning and Growth
description: Our campus provides a safe, comfortable and engaging environment where students can learn, explore, play and develop their creativity throughout the school day.

cardItem.title: Smart Classrooms
cardItem.description: Spacious, well-lit classrooms with digital boards to make learning interactive, engaging and easy to understand.

cardItem.title: Science Laboratories
cardItem.description: Well-equipped physics, chemistry and biology labs for practical learning and scientific exploration.

cardItem.title: Computer Lab
cardItem.description: Modern computers that help students develop coding, digital and design skills through hands-on learning.

cardItem.title: Library
cardItem.description: A peaceful reading space with a growing collection of books to encourage reading, creativity and a love for learning.

cardItem.title: Sports Facilities
cardItem.description: Well-maintained sports areas for games, physical fitness and team practice under the guidance of coaches.

cardItem.title: Playground
cardItem.description: Safe and child-friendly play areas where students can enjoy outdoor activities, develop physical skills and have fun with friends.

cardItem.title: Hostel & Mess
cardItem.description: A comfortable and supervised residential environment with nutritious meals to support students’ health, safety and well-being.

cardItem.title: Art & Music Rooms
cardItem.description: Dedicated spaces where students can explore their creativity and develop their artistic and musical talents.

section-7.heading: Student Life
section-7.mainHeading: Every Day is a New Learning Experience
description: From morning assemblies and sports competitions to cultural events, science exhibitions and reading activities, life at Indian Public School, Sambalpur, is filled with learning, creativity, fun and new experiences.

section-8.heading: A Legacy of Excellence. A Future of Possibilities.

cardItem.title: Pre-Primary School
cardItem.description: Play-based learning that develops early communication, creativity, basic skills and social confidence.

cardItem.title: Primary School
cardItem.description: Building strong foundations in language, mathematics, science and essential life skills through engaging activities.

cardItem.title: Middle School
cardItem.description: Encouraging critical thinking, practical learning, and subject knowledge through projects, experiments and teamwork.

cardItem.title: Secondary School
cardItem.description: Focused academic learning, regular assessments, and exam preparation to help students achieve their goals.

cardItem.title: Senior Secondary School
cardItem.description: Advanced subject learning, career guidance and preparation for higher education and future opportunities.

section-8.title: A Legacy of Excellence. A Future of Possibilities.
section-8.videoTitle: A Legacy of Excellence. A Future of Possibilities.

section-9.heading: Best CBSE School in Odisha
section-9.subHeading: A Premier Day Cum Co-Educational CBSE Residential School
section-9.description:
At Indian Public School, Sambalpur, we are committed to providing quality education in a supportive and inspiring learning environment. Our dedicated teachers and experienced management team work together to ensure a meaningful and enriching educational experience for every student.

We encourage students to learn independently and collaboratively, respect others and develop a strong sense of responsibility towards society and the environment. Through academics, creative activities and meaningful interactions, students build friendships, explore their interests and enjoy their school journey.

Above all, we nurture self-esteem, confidence and individual potential, empowering every child to recognize their abilities, overcome challenges and strive for a bright and successful future.
